10 simple things you can do today to help your weight loss journey🤞🏾

1. Eating too little — Your body needs enough food and energy to function properly. 2. Expecting overnight results — Healthy progress takes time, so be patient with yourself. 3. Ignoring your daily steps — Using a walking app can help you track your steps, stay motivated and work towards your daily movement goals! (I use Fastwalk) 4. Not drinking enough water — Keep a water bottle nearby and drink regularly throughout the day. 5. Doing workouts you hate — Find activities you genuinely enjoy so it’s easier to stay consistent. 6. Comparing your progress to others — Everyone’s body and journey are different, so focus on yourself. 7. Being too hard on yourself — Remember, consistency matters more than perfection. Some months I’ve lost 10 pounds, and other months I’ve barely lost 0.2 pounds. And throughout all of those ups and downs, I’ve maintained the same consistency. Walking for 30 minutes every single day, focusing on getting 100 grams of protein, and staying hydrated. The crazy part is that I was doing the exact same things during the months I barely lost anything as I was during the months I lost a ton. And I think that really goes to show just how important consistency is. Progress isn’t always linear, and the scale isn’t always going to reflect the work you’re putting in. But that doesn’t mean what you’re doing isn’t working. You have to keep showing up for yourself every single day, regardless of what the scale says, how you’re feeling, or whether or not you’re motivated. Because at the end of the day, it’s not about what you do for a few days or even a few weeks. It’s about what you continue doing over time. And I truly believe that’s what makes the biggest difference. Not perfection, not motivation, just consistency and the willingness to keep going even when you’re not seeing the results you hoped for. #PostpartumWeightLoss #WeightLossJourney #ConsistencyOverMotivation #WalkingForWeightLoss #postpartumfitness
